title: God Calls Abraham
reflectionQuestion: What do you think it was like for Abraham to set out, not yet knowing where God was leading him?
kidSafetyNotes: Trust before you can see: God calls Abraham to a land he can't yet see; Abraham goes. Gentle, no peril. Center = 'he did not know the way ahead, but he knew the One who was leading him.' Grounding: tents under a sky of more stars than he could count (Gen 12 call + the stars promise). Mood calm_peaceful (quiet trust on the journey). Part of the not-alone spine -- God beside him every step.

scriptureKeyVerse.text: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.
